entries.subject: Berthier 2014 projected-limb solution
entries.finding: The selected projected equivalent diameter is 23.1±0.7 km and ellipse ratio 2.7±0.3. The authored model assumes unseen depth equals the short axis; this is one admissible three-dimensional interpretation, not a unique measured shape.

entries.subject: Herald 2020 correlated ellipse alternatives
entries.finding: The retained record notes strong covariance between axes and orientation and an alternative 25±1 km diameter. The package continues to display its explicitly illustrative 2014 family member.
entries.revisitWhen: A joint chord and covariance analysis supports choosing or comparing another documented shape-family member.

entries.subject: 2021 Sylvia-system orbit and Miriade 2024 comparison
entries.finding: The fixed-epoch orbit uses the 2021 system parameters. The retained newer-solution comparison differs by about 42 milliarcseconds at the scene epoch and 23–63 over six checks; it supports approximate context, not reproduction of the paper fit RMS.

entries.subject: Sylvia primary mesh and unresolved companion images
entries.finding: The historical review distinguishes the released primary Sylvia mesh from its companion and the Romulus occultation silhouette from terrain imagery. Neither supplies a measured Romulus surface map.
entries.revisitWhen: A Romulus-specific numerical surface or controlled resolved observation is released.
